name: Agent Identity Review Gate
description: Copilot Studio agent accounts, with their own Entra Agent ID, shared memory and event triggers, are in preview. A go-live gate for one: who owns it, what it may decide on its own, how its Copilot Credits are capped and what is audited, with a Go, Go with conditions or No go verdict, the evidence behind it, the open questions and a tenant test plan.
author: Arindam Choudhury
